SELECT 
  season,
  round,
  game_date,
  day,
  win_market,
  win_name,
  win_alias,
  win_pts,
  lose_market,
  lose_name,
  lose_alias,
  lose_pts,
  num_ot
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
WHERE season BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018
AND (win_market IN ('Memphis', 'South Florida', 'Missouri', 'UNLV', 'Duke') 
     OR lose_market IN ('Memphis', 'South Florida', 'Missouri', 'UNLV', 'Duke'))
ORDER BY season, game_date
